SUMMARY: VeloSwap
DESCRIPTION:
Save the date for the 34th year of VeloSwap! VeloSwap offers epic end-of-the-season deals and fun for the whole family. Join cyclists at VeloSwap on November 7th at the National Western Complex in Denver for Colorado’s largest bike sale of the year. Over 250 local and national vendors will be selling bikes, wheels, tires, clothing, gear, and more. The one-day event will feature prize giveaways, bike demos, and a kids’ bike rodeo. Ticket and exhibitor sales, Bicycle Colorado merchandise booth, and sponsorships will benefit Bicycle Colorado and our advocacy work across Colorado. 
View Event Website For More Information
LOCATION: National Western Complex, 4655 N Humboldt St, Denver, 80216, United States

SUMMARY: Bike Ride with Cultura with Bici Libre and Dia de los Muertos Celebration
DESCRIPTION:
This is your sign to get outside! Come ride with us on N Table & Blunn Reservoir Route.
A great option for a gravel ride starting and ending at 1300 10th St, Golden, CO 80401. We will meet at 7:30 a.m. to roll at 8:00 a.m.
This ride is approximately 15 miles long and offers a mix of gravel paths and scenic views. Miles of beautiful mountain trails, good vibes, and the best community around. And after the ride? We are heading to El dia de los muertos celebration at Lions Park!!! 
Sign the Latino Outdoors Waiver 
https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/e/SlL9pYsWarlBK3SRviCwIX/ 
Since we’re planning food for everyone, if you are staying to the Dia de los Muertos celebration, please register in that event as well. Before you register, please check that you will be able to make it. 
If your plans change and you can’t come, please cancel your ticket so someone else can have the chance to join us and enjoy the food. Thank you so much for helping us make room for our whole community!
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
¡Esta es tu señal para salir! Ven a montar con nosotros en la ruta N Table & Blunn Reservoir.
Una excelente opción para un paseo en gravel que comienza y termina en 1300 10th St, Golden, CO 80401
Nos reuniremos a las 7:30 a.m. para rodar a las 8:00 a.m.
Este paseo tiene aproximadamente 15 millas de largo y ofrece una mezcla de caminos de grava y vistas panorámicas. Table, millas de hermosos senderos montañosos, buenas vibras y la mejor comunidad que hay. ¿Y después del paseo? Nos dirigimos a la celebracion del dia de los muertos en el parque de Lions. 
Firmar la exención de Latinos Outdoors
https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/e/SlL9pYsWarlBK3SRviCwIX/ 
Como estamos planeando la comida para todos, por favor asegúrate de inscribirse en el evento del Dia de los Muertos, para tener un conteo exacto. Antes de registrarte, confirma que realmente podrá asistir. 
Si tus planes cambian y no puedes venir, por favor cancela tu boleto para que otra persona tenga la oportunidad de unirse y disfrutar de la comida. ¡Muchas gracias por ayudarnos a hacer espacio para toda nuestra comunidad!
LOCATION: Lions Park Golden, CO

SUMMARY: Rise n Ride Commuter Group Bicycle Rides
DESCRIPTION: Join Community Cycles for Rise n’ Ride, a free weekly group bike ride designed to help people build confidence biking for transportation. Whether you’re new to commuting by bike or looking for a supportive group to ride with, everyone is welcome. The ride meets every Wednesday morning at the US 36/McCaslin Park-n-Ride (North Side) at 7:20am and follows a comfortable pace with experienced ride leaders. Learn more about bike commuting, connect with fellow riders, and discover how biking can become part of your daily routine.
LOCATION: McCaslin Park n Ride, Superior, CO, United States

SUMMARY: Boulder Cup
DESCRIPTION:
The legendary cyclocross weekend returns to Valmont Bike Park this November 14-15, 2026! Two full days of world-class competition and a celebration of everything we love about cycling. 
The Boulder Cup has long been one of the premier UCI cyclocross events in the U.S. — and now it’s back, stronger than ever.

SUMMARY: Bikerpelli
DESCRIPTION:
Ride the Kokopelli Trail, fully supported! Fruita, CO – Moab, UT, 142 miles, 3 days.
We have been offering these annual group trips for 20+ years, and take pride in facilitating the adventure of a lifetime for riders like you! Our experienced staff handles everything: daily route briefings, gear shuttle, aid stations, home cooked meals, fantastic camps, mechanical and medical support, shuttles, SAG wagon, and return shuttle at the end of the ride. The trail is amazing, but the community and vibe are also a highlight of these trips! Join us this Spring and see why we have a 40% return rate- we will do our very best to show you the very best time on the Kokopelli!
LOCATION: Kokopelli Trail
